framework: review-specific mixed-method risk-of-bias and applicability appraisal

dimensions.name: internal validity
dimensions.rationale: Descriptive survey with no comparison group and unclear random-selection procedure.

dimensions.name: measurement validity
dimensions.rationale: Preference for human customer-service agents is not equivalent to preference or performance in research interviews.

dimensions.name: external validity
dimensions.rationale: Single Serbian convenience-like sample and rule-based 2021 chatbot.

applicability: Contextual trust and adoption evidence only; not an interviewer-effect estimate.
